title: 1,210 gravitational-lens candidates in the DESI Legacy Surveys
summary: Applied to DR8 data from the DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys, machine learning found 1,210 strong gravitational-lens candidates. The DESI collaboration says this is about twice the number of lenses known at the time; these are candidates, not objects individually confirmed in every case.
organization: NSF NOIRLab; University of San Francisco, and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory

evidence.tested: Candidates were selected by applying trained networks to survey images and visually inspecting the top-ranked ones; the sources read describe no spectroscopic confirmation or held-out test.
evidence.ai_role: Deep residual neural networks trained on known lenses and non-lenses found 1,210 strong-lens candidates in DESI Legacy Imaging Survey DR8 data.
